source_doc: Rencana Proyek Perangkat Lunak: Platform Transparansi Harga dan Marketplace B2B Agrikultur Jawa Timur v1.0

legend.assumption: Value proposed by planner, needs confirmation
legend.open_decision: Not decided yet; do not hardcode

project.name: agri-price-b2b-platform
project.summary: Public national wholesale price transparency dashboard (PIHPS data, daily, trading-style UI) plus a B2B agri marketplace (farmers/cooperatives to restaurants, SMEs, cafes, hotels) limited to major East Java cities.
non_goals: sales outside major East Java cities
own logistics fleet or own warehouse
commodities other than vegetables and rice

needs: manage users, catalog, transactions, ads, subscriptions

data_source.name: PIHPS
data_source.coverage: national; province and city level where available; East Java featured
data_source.label_policy: Never label as 'realtime'. Show 'updated daily' and last-updated timestamp.
data_source.commercial_strategy: monetize analytics and service, not raw data

price_dashboard.ui_style: trading-app style (ticker board, line and daily candlestick charts, up/down indicators)
price_dashboard.disclaimer: Information only. Not a trading or speculation facility.

features.desc: Commodity list with last price and daily/weekly/monthly change (nominal and percent)
Per-commodity charts; ranges 7d, 30d, 1y, custom; line and candlestick
Heatmap or table of price differences across provinces and cities
Source, calculation, definition of reference price, limitations, revision history
Limited in free, full in premium

transparency_rules: Reference prices are public without login
Reference price (PIHPS) and marketplace transaction price are strictly separated and labeled separately
Marketplace prices never alter reference price figures
Per-farmer and per-buyer transaction details are private; only anonymous aggregates may be public

marketplace.model: B2B, sellers (cooperatives/farmer groups) to small-medium business buyers

grade_system.criteria: written per commodity; vegetables: size, freshness, damage rate; rice: moisture, broken grain; refer to SNI where relevant

order_flow.action: search, select listing, create order (quantity, delivery date)
pay full amount upfront via managed payment; funds held until receipt confirmed
confirm and prepare goods per ordered grade
receive and inspect within claim window
release funds to seller minus commission after confirmation or window expiry
if claim: dispute resolution using photo and QC evidence; partial or full refund

payment_policy.credit_terms: not offered initially; evaluate limited terms for verified buyers after transaction history exists

qc.recommended: risk-based sampling: more for new sellers, perishables, high-value orders
qc.effects: feeds seller reputation score; repeated failures lead to downgrade or suspension

initial_integration: proof of delivery (photo or digital signature)
logistics.later: consider simple collection point to consolidate orders

disintermediation_controls: managed payment and dispute protection as core value
contact details released only after transaction and only as needed for delivery
reputation score, access to new buyers, loyalty and volume incentives

principles: Ads and promotions must not influence reference price figures
Ads and promotions must be clearly labeled
Commercialization goal: cover system maintenance; compute break-even early

common: registration and login (dashboard public without login)
role-based access: public, seller, buyer, admin, qc

non_functional_requirements.performance: fast load on typical mobile connections; mobile-first
reliability: daily ingestion job monitored with failure alerts
security: no own card data storage (delegate to payment provider)
usability: optional WhatsApp-based order flow for some sellers
non_functional_requirements.data_integrity: audit log for every change to prices, listings, transactions; no blockchain in early phase
non_functional_requirements.scalability: modular architecture; extensible to more cities, commodities, data sources

database.timeseries: indexed tables with aggregation; consider time-series extension if volume grows

ingestion.normalization: map PIHPS commodity names, units, regions to consistent internal schema

architecture.cache: Redis or simple cache for frequent dashboard endpoints
architecture.payments: local payment gateway (virtual account, e-wallet, QRIS) with fund-holding support per provider and regulation

entities: PriceObservation(commodity, region, date, price, source, raw_ref, ingested_at)
Listing(seller, commodity, grade, price, stock, photos, availability)
constraints: PriceObservation is append-only; revisions create new versions
Reference price and marketplace price stored in separate tables

roadmap.name: Preparation
tasks: review PIHPS terms and data structure
choose initial commodities, define reference price
set up legal entity and PSE registration
write grade criteria with food expert
validate with users and 6 supply partners

roadmap.name: Price dashboard
tasks: ticker, trend charts, region comparison, methodology page
free public launch, collect feedback, measure traffic

roadmap.name: Marketplace pilot
tasks: onboard 6 partners, initial vegetable and rice listings
order flow, managed prepaid payment, courier integration, QC
limited launch in one city with limited buyers
measure GMV, repeat orders, claim rate, delivery time, operating margin

roadmap.name: Monetization and hardening
tasks: reputation score, mature dispute module, partner reports

roadmap.name: Expansion
tasks: add East Java cities, commodities, logistics partners
evaluate collection point or shared warehouse
evaluate blockchain only if non-government data or provenance need arises

risks.mitigation: check in phase 0; sell analytics value-add; consider formal cooperation
store own history, monitor format changes, add sources if permitted
multiple suppliers per commodity, stock buffer, availability communication
packaging standards, delivery windows, vetted logistics, clear claim policy
escrow and claim protection; evaluate limited credit terms later

risks.risk: Conflict of interest (price provider and marketplace)
risks.mitigation: separate reference vs transaction prices, open methodology, labeled ads
clear disclaimer; no contract trading or speculation features
phased scope, simple monolith, strict prioritization, hire help
simple UI, cooperative-led onboarding, WhatsApp channel
compute break-even; test commission and subscription during pilot
automated validation, quality flags, methodology notes

legal_compliance_checklist: PSE registration and personal data protection compliance
payment and fund-holding via licensed providers
food safety and quality rules for fresh food distribution
terms of service, privacy policy, dispute/refund policy
agreements with cooperatives, farmer groups, logistics partners
open_decisions: commission rate, subscription price, ad rates
claim window length for fresh produce and rice
actual PIHPS wholesale commodity and region coverage
logistics partner and payment gateway selection
collection point or warehouse need in expansion
next_actions_30_days: review PIHPS terms and run test data pull to map commodities, units, regions
decide reference price definition and draft methodology page
define vegetable and rice grade criteria with food expert
shortlist logistics partners and payment gateways and compare costs
build simple financial model with break-even
produce dashboard wireframes and start phase 1 development
